title: Spotify will label ‘AI Persona’ profiles and exclude their music from recommendations
summary: Spotify is introducing 'AI Persona' labels for artist profiles representing AI-generated identities and will exclude their music from editorial, algorithmic, and personalized recommendations by default. The move aims to distinguish human artists from synthetic identities while protecting the recommendation ecosystem.
content: Spotify is introducing “AI Persona” labels for artist profiles that represent AI-generated identities and will exclude their music from editorial, algorithmic, and personalized recommendations by default.

zh.title: Spotify将为"AI虚拟人物"档案添加标签，并将其音乐从推荐中排除
zh.summary: Spotify正在为代表AI生成身份的艺术家档案引入"AI虚拟人物"标签，并将在默认情况下从编辑、算法和个性化推荐中排除其音乐。此举旨在区分人类艺术家和合成身份，同时保护推荐生态系统。

title: What comes after the smartphone? Amazon’s Panos Panay will make his case at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
summary: Amazon's Panos Panay will present an exclusive vision at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 about what comes after smartphones. The appearance signals Amazon's ambition to shape the next major computing paradigm beyond mobile devices.
content: At Disrupt 2026, Amazon's Panos Panay will provide an exclusive vision for what's in store for us beyond the smartphone.

zh.title: 智能手机之后会是什么？亚马逊的Panos Panay将在TechCrunch Disrupt 2026上阐述其观点
zh.summary: 亚马逊的Panos Panay将在TechCrunch Disrupt 2026上展示关于智能手机之后是什么的独家愿景。此次出现表明亚马逊有雄心塑造超越移动设备的下一个主要计算范式。

title: Anthropic says it will watermark text generated by its AI models
summary: Anthropic is expanding watermarking support to mark text generated by its AI models, including extending the capability to older model versions. The effort aims to improve transparency around AI-generated content.
content: Anthropic will extend support for watermarking AI generations for older models as well.

zh.title: Anthropic表示将对其AI模型生成的文本进行水印处理
zh.summary: Anthropic正在扩展水印支持，以标记其AI模型生成的文本，包括将该功能扩展到旧的模型版本。此举旨在改善围绕AI生成内容的透明度。

title: New Pass-ta-key attack reveals all the things we didn't know about passkeys
summary: A new 'Pass-ta-key' attack exploits how passkey applications handle Windows differently from other operating systems, revealing unknown security vulnerabilities. The findings highlight implementation gaps that could be exploited across platforms.
content: Why passkey apps treat Windows differently than other operating systems.

zh.title: 新型 Pass-ta-key 攻击揭示了我们对密钥认证的未知之处
zh.summary: 新的"Pass-ta-key"攻击利用密钥应用对 Windows 的处理方式与其他操作系统的不同之处，揭示了未知的安全漏洞。这些发现强调了可能在各平台上被利用的实现漏洞。

title: OpenAI reportedly completed a $7 billion employee tender offer
summary: OpenAI completed a $7 billion tender offer for employees, allowing staff to liquidate equity holdings. The massive transaction reflects the company's substantial valuation and ongoing competition for AI talent.
content: San Francisco's housing market is in trouble again.

zh.title: OpenAI据报完成了70亿美元员工股权收购
zh.summary: OpenAI完成了一项70亿美元的员工股权收购，允许员工清算其股权持有。这笔巨大交易反映了该公司的巨大估值和对AI人才的持续竞争。
